snippet.title: CODA for Playdate - Full Gameplay - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Full Gameplay of CODA for the Playdate. Captured using Playdate Simulator at 4k and played using an 8bitdo Ultimate with crank mapped to Right Analogue Stick.

Review here: https://youtu.be/w7WEQiWLCGI
